mohammed.notes: white djellaba, shaved head with a tuft. 'fete' (s20 b086 →): stiff starched shirt, red embroidered gilet (#b3142c) UNDER a white fine-wool djellaba, embroidered satchel strap, oversized yellow babouches. Gilet never over the djellaba (ep06 error).

zoubida.notes: 'fete' (s24 →): mansouria with yellow satin stripes, festive headscarf

father.notes: s20 on: fine wool djellaba (same model, lighter tint)

fqih.notes: 'fete' (s22-s23): black-and-white striped djellaba, grey burnous, NO quince rod (first time: key image b099)

kanza.notes: Lalla Kanza the chouafa: old, smiling, eyes half-closed; FEMALE voice (Vindemiatrix)

aicha.notes: Lalla Aïcha (ep02-03 continuity), wife of Moulay Larbi; plump, lively, theatrical hands

hammoussa.notes: NEW Rodin. Azzouz Berrada 'pois chiche': the tiniest pupil, too-big beige djellaba, sleeves over his hands

barber.notes: NEW Rodin. Si Abderrahman: lively, sly eyes, short beard, white apron over a green-striped shirt, skullcap. Talks with his hands

hammad.notes: NEW Rodin. Oncle Hammad: dry, goat beard, monumental turban, groaning

lamrani.notes: NEW Rodin. Sidi Ahmed Lamrani: young, waxy-white skin, crow-black beard, fine white djellaba, poet's calm

client.notes: barber's client: shown from BEHIND only (shaved nape, cherry-red ears)

teen.notes: NEW Rodin. older boy roaring on a trumpet (s18 terrace concert)
